description: Presenting an incredible “South of Blvd” opportunity to obtain this nearly 3,500 sq. ft. home situated on a sprawling gated lot of over 18,000 sq. ft. Reside in just as it is, remodel to align with your style or completely remove and craft a new dream for yourself or the many that would desire to acquire your masterpiece. Inside this warm traditional floorplan, ceilings spanning over 20 feet welcome you in. Kitchen with cozy breakfast nook adjoins a spacious formal dining room. Large family room features a corner fireplace and French doors to the rear. Open & bright living room offers ample windows and fireplace with a stunning surround. An ensuite and powder bath complete the lower level. Along the stairwell & upper landing, desirable wall space exists to exhibit your prized pieces. Spacious primary suite affords a private balcony overlooking the vast yard and surrounding tranquil lush foliage. Desirable Jack and Jill bedrooms enhance the appeal. Outside, expansive rear grounds deliver a refreshing pool, soothing spa, sizeable grassy area and an untapped upper portion ready and waiting for your magic touch. Great schools and only a short stroll to the Blvd. Come explore all the possibilities!
